summary: A sampler firmware with two chopped song tracks and 16 drum pads sharing 500 KiB of sample memory, with a step sequencer, arrangement and USB audio recording into the device. Built on Felucca; final beta.
features: Two songs of up to 32 chops each, plus 16 drum pads
Per-chop start, end, direction, tuning, gain, envelope and loop crossfade
Record samples from the computer over USB audio, with trim
1-64 steps, four notes per step, piano roll, patterns A-D, 16-section song
Mixer, choke groups, filter, delay, chorus, reverb, distortion, compression
Browser loader, emulator and backups; no synth engines

headings: pigeon — sampler firmware for the m-vave fm1
